Medical providers across the country are feeling the consequences of the One Big Beautiful Bill’s Medicaid budget cuts. The law won’t take effect until 2027, but Republicans are already dealing with the backlash. Vox’s Rachel Booth explains how the cuts could lead to fewer services and higher health care costs — even for people who keep their insurance.

snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE 2028 and wondering how to manage your preparation alongside college or a full-time job?

Join this UPSC 2028 Strategy Webinar with Abhijeet Jain, AIR 170, UPSC CSE 2025, who cleared the examination in his first attempt while working as a professional.

Learn how to approach UPSC preparation with a focused **5-hour daily study plan**, build a structured preparation strategy, and balance your UPSC journey with college or work commitments.

Webinar Details:
📅 Date: 3 November 2026
⏰ Time: 2:00 PM
📍 Mode: Online & Offline
🔗 Register Now: https://shorturl.at/GzsaA

Don't let limited study hours hold back your UPSC ambitions. Learn from someone who has successfully managed both work and preparation.

#upsc2028  #upscpreparation  #upscstrategy  #upscbeginners  #workingprofessionals  #collegestudents  #FirstAttempt #AIR170 #levelupias
